projects.summary: Use staged change, explicit validation, and pre-written rollback when a task can affect live access, routing, storage, or service ownership.
Turn recurring checks into structured evidence, small deterministic summaries, and approval-gated follow-up instead of repeated manual reconstruction.
Keep cloud assets, Terraform intent, recurring validation, and change evidence close enough together that the assistant can reason across all of them safely.
Move backups and operational exports onto nas-1 so the environment stops depending on forgotten desktop paths.
